The QB Sack Responsibility Ratio (R) quantifies quarterback liability in sack events, computed as ratio of self-caused sacks to total sacks, normalized across seasons. This is used in GSE to simulate defensive pressure adjustments and evaluate quarterback durability. The Fast Starter Yardage Decline Rate (D) captures regression-to-mean effects in early-season performers, calculated as percentage change in average yards per game between first and second halves of season.
